why: After the first failure (square A4+K8+C4+self at n = 197, a third of the full bound), while the run was in progress: the two rules of the six shells that are perfect cubes, N4+K8+C4 = N4^3 and A4+K8+C4+self = (N4 + self)^3, must have period p / gcd(p, 3) at odd n, where p is the cube root's period, which the pattern puts at P90(n) for N4 and the full bound for N4 + self. So the registered predictions for these two rules should fail exactly where 3 divides p, and every other registered prediction is unaffected. Not registered: an expectation written down before these records exist.

dilation.why: After the first failure outside the cubes (square C4+self at n = 141: 2^23 - 1, not the full bound 2^46 - 1), while the run was in progress. C4 + self is (N4 + self)(x^3, y^3). When 3 divides n, x -> x^3 maps the n-torus's group ring onto that of the n/3-torus, and F2[Z_n^2] is a free module of rank 9 over that image, so C4 + self has N4 + self's period on the n/3 torus; the pattern puts that at the full bound of n/3. When 3 does not divide n, x -> x^3 is an automorphism and nothing changes. The only rules of the six shells in x^3, y^3 are C4 and C4 + self; C4 has no registered prediction. Not registered.
